projects.title: Sushi Guy
projects.description: Sushi Guy is a frontend website concept for a private chef and catering service. It features a clean, user-friendly booking experience where customers can explore culinary services, choose an experience, provide their event details, and proceed through a prepayment flow. The project focuses on the website’s design, layout, responsiveness, and overall user experience.

projects.title: CabangRun
projects.description: CabangRun is a frontend website concept for a local running club, designed to showcase the club’s past races, upcoming events, activities, and achievements. The website provides a central space for runners and visitors to explore the club’s events, learn more about its activities, and stay connected with the local running community.

projects.title: Bomb Taco
projects.description: Designed and developed a modern, responsive website for Bomb Taco, focusing on a bold visual identity that reflects the brand’s energetic personality. I handled both the UI/UX design and full website development, ensuring a seamless, engaging, and user-friendly experience.

projects.title: Big Island Cleaners
projects.description: Implemented the provided website design using WordPress, translating the approved design into a responsive and functional website. I handled the WordPress development and ensured the site accurately reflected the intended layout, content, and user experience.

projects.title: Broken Wrench Repair, LLC
projects.description: Developed a professional and responsive website for an automotive service business. I handled the website development, implementing the design and content to create a user-friendly experience that showcases their automotive maintenance, cleaning, and repair services.

projects.title: REMYNEWYORK
projects.description: Developed a Shopify e-commerce website for a lifestyle brand inspired by Vietnamese culture and craftsmanship. I handled the Shopify development and customization, creating a polished, responsive storefront that reflects the brand’s story while providing a seamless shopping experience.

projects.title: Flooring Surgeons
projects.description: Maintained and enhanced a WordPress website for Flooring Surgeons. I added new pages, sections, and features while making ongoing updates and improvements to ensure the site remained functional, user-friendly, and aligned with the business’s evolving needs.

projects.title: The Queen BNB
projects.description: Developed a website for The Queen BNB, a charming hospitality business centered around its historic property and personal story. I handled the website development, creating a warm, engaging, and user-friendly experience that highlights the property, its history, and the welcoming atmosphere of the brand.

projects.title: Duron Ranch
projects.description: Built and developed a personal blog and content website for The Duron Ranch using Systeme.io. I handled the implementation and customization of the site, creating a structured and engaging platform that showcases Rene’s story, projects, DIY experience, tool reviews, and budget-friendly tips.

projects.title: Evans Performance Advisors (EPA)
projects.description: Developed a professional website for EPA using Wix, implementing the brand’s vision and content into a polished, engaging, and responsive online presence. I focused on structuring the site to clearly communicate the organization’s mission and help showcase its athlete-focused approach to visibility, confidence, and identity.

projects.title: Fan Day Nation
projects.description: Customized and implemented a Shopify e-commerce website for Fan Day Nation, creating a responsive and engaging online store that aligns with the brand’s sports-focused identity. I handled the Shopify theme customization, page structure, and overall user experience to effectively showcase the brand and its products.

projects.title: Niko Stones
projects.description: Customized and implemented an e-commerce website for Niko Stones Jewelry, creating a polished and responsive online store for its collection of necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and rings. I handled the website customization and development, focusing on product presentation, collection organization, and a smooth shopping experience.
